integrity: The unrestricted proof is self-contained and uses odd-prime lifting plus CRT. Finite checks are corroboration only. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula assumes odd moduli and bases coprime to them. It does not address a global density asymptotic, the number of Wieferich primes, even moduli, or independent priority certification. The main method is classical odd-prime order lifting.
title: Exact prime-support thresholds for generalized non-Wieferich integers
